title: Wear app: Calculator shows ISF value at the IC field.
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.0.0.2-dev-j**
**Build:** #b4373071
**Flavor:** Fullrelease

**Watch:** Samsung Galaxy Watch4 44mm
**Wear App:** 2022.05.08

**Problem description:**

Calculator (from tile) shows ISF value at the IC field.

![watch](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45144129/168158929-da144735-0b64-429c-bafc-5c14645621fc.png)

comments.body:
Appears linked to #1727, i get the same with Dev that carbs entered get zero calculated insulin to be delivered (even after full uninstall and reinstall).
Galaxy Watch 4, 40mm.

Not sure if this fits best here or in its own ticket,  but since it's freaking with incorrect data from the calculator I thought it would be good here. 

It looks like for the dosage from the calculator it's multiplying it by 0% instead of the configured percentage.
